de: Im Wald leben viele wilde Tiere.
en: Many wild animals live in the forest.

de: Die Party gestern war ziemlich wild.
en: The party yesterday was pretty wild.

expect.en: That's rather expensive. ≈ That's more expensive than I would’ve thought.

de: Ich bin müde, aber ich muss noch arbeiten.
en: I am tired, but I still have to work.

expect.en: Look how tall you’ve become! (said to a child)

de: Das Zimmer ist klein, aber sehr hell.
en: The room is small but very bright.

expect.def: rather; quite; unusually; used with adjectives to express a surprising degree, whether this surprise be real or for effect

def: Joins two statements that pull against each other — but. The same word is also one of the commonest flavouring particles, where it adds a note of surprise to a statement rather than joining anything.
